mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise in the same month, the 5d forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2.0% over one month indicates a supply shock, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls > 2.0% in 1 month, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month reflects a strengthening labor market, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over one month signals rising inflation, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) over the past month indicates stagflation risk, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises in the same month, the 5d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 0.5% signals a recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 declines > 0.5% q/q, the 60d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
